final: WITH hand_counts AS (SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(p.throws), ''), '') AS hand, COUNT(*) AS tally FROM player_award AS a JOIN player AS p ON p.player_id = a.player_id GROUP BY COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(p.throws), ''), '')), hand_shares AS (SELECT tally, tally * 1.0 / SUM(tally) OVER () AS share FROM hand_counts), shares_with_average AS (SELECT tally, share, AVG(share) OVER () AS average_share FROM hand_shares) SELECT SUM(tally), AVG(share), AVG(share - average_share) FROM shares_with_average WHERE share > average_share
